levels.name: Common irregular words
levels.examples: of → ov, said → sed, does → duz, one → wun, could → cud

levels.name: a after w sounding like 'hot'
levels.examples: what → wot, want → wont, watch → wotch, wash → wosh

levels.name: Unexpected silent letters
levels.examples: debt → det, island → iland, hour → our, answer → anser

levels.name: ough/augh by sound
levels.examples: though → tho, through → thru, enough → enuff, laugh → laff

levels.name: ch sounding like k or sh
levels.examples: school → skool, stomach → stomak, machine → mashine

levels.name: o / ou sounding like 'cup'
levels.examples: love → luv, mother → muther, young → yung, blood → blud

levels.name: ea that isn't 'ee'
levels.examples: head → hed, great → grate, learn → lern, heart → hart

levels.name: o / ou sounding like 'food'
levels.examples: move → moov, soup → soop, shoe → shoo

levels.name: ough / augh sounding like 'saw'
levels.examples: thought → thawt, caught → cawt, daughter → dawter

levels.name: Short vowel + ve
levels.examples: have → hav, give → giv

levels.name: ui sounding like 'it'
levels.examples: build → bild, guilt → gilt

levels.name: ere sounding like 'care'
levels.examples: there → thare, where → whare

levels.name: wh → w
levels.examples: what → wat, when → wen, which → wich, white → wite

levels.name: ow sounding like 'know'
levels.examples: know → no, knowing → noing, own → oan, bowl → boal

levels.name: Long vowel before two consonants
levels.examples: find → finde, child → childe, most → moste, ghost → ghoste

levels.name: oo sounding like 'book'
levels.examples: book → buk, good → gud, look → luk

levels.name: ei / ey / eigh sounding like 'day'
levels.examples: they → thay, eight → ate, weigh → way

levels.name: Silent letters at the start: kn, wr, gn, gh, rh
levels.examples: write → rite, knife → nife, ghost → gost, rhythm → rythm

levels.name: ph → f
levels.examples: phone → fone, photo → foto, graph → graf

levels.name: igh → i
levels.examples: night → nite, light → lite, high → hi, height → hite

levels.name: The -ive ending
levels.examples: active → activ, positive → positiv

levels.name: Unpronounced vowels
levels.examples: every → evry, different → diffrent
